basic_details.job_title: HBCHRC One Year Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview for One Year Fellow at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre (HBCHRC), Punjab, is on 18 December 2026, between 09.00 A.M. and 11.00 A.M. The venue is Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Plot No. 1, Medicity, New Chandigarh, Punjab-140901. There is one post in Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery (Surgical Oncology), with gross pay of Rs. 1,33,623/- to Rs. 1,45,530/- per month for one year from the date of joining. The centre is a Tata Memorial Centre unit, a grant-in-aid institute under the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India.

age_limit.details: Maximum up to 45 Yrs. Age and experience are reckoned as on the date of the walk-in interview, and experience is reckoned after the required qualifications. The limit is relaxable for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates as per Government of India instructions.

important_instructions: Persons working under Central / State Government / Autonomous Body / Semi Government Organizations and other PSUs must obtain permission from their Head of the Organization and produce it at the interview, failing which they shall not be allowed to appear. The post is for a tenure of one year from the date of appointment. TMC may also offer appointments for a fixed term, initially for one year, on a consolidated remuneration. Appointed candidates may be rotated to any Unit of TMC as and when necessary: Tata Memorial Hospital, Mumbai; ACTREC, Navi Mumbai; Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, Sangrur; Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Mullanpur; Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Visakhapatnam; Mahamana Pt. Madan Mohan Malviya Cancer Centre (BHU), Varanasi; Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, Varanasi; BBCI, Guwahati. Sharing accommodation may be provided to Senior Residents/One Year Fellows, subject to availability, on a chargeable basis. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature. Candidature will be cancelled if the candidate does not fulfil the eligibility criteria or has given incorrect, false or incomplete information or suppressed any material fact. If a shortcoming is found even after appointment, services are liable to be terminated forthwith. For enquiries, email [email protected]. No phone calls will be entertained. Legal jurisdiction for any dispute is at SAS Nagar.

content_sections.heading: About the Centre
content_sections.text: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Punjab is a Tata Memorial Centre, Mumbai institute, a grant-in-aid institute under the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India. The notice is issued by its Academics Department for the New Chandigarh centre and signed by the Director, HBCH & RC, Punjab.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian Nationals for the post of One Year Fellow in the Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery (Surgical Oncology) division for a period of one year from the date of joining. There is one post. MCh (Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery/Plastic Surgery) or DrNB (Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery/Plastic Surgery) or equivalent recognized by MCI/NMC. For this post the notice prints no separate experience requirement. Maximum up to 45 Yrs. Age and experience are reckoned as on the date of the walk-in interview, and experience is reckoned after the required qualifications. The limit is relaxable for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates as per Government of India instructions. If the post is only for the unreserved category, age relaxation does not apply to reserved candidates. Reservation applies as per Government rules. The salary is determined by the relevant work experience acquired after completion of the essential qualification. The notice sends candidates to the official notification for the full eligibility terms.

rows.relaxation: 10 years (additional 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC)
Length of service in Armed forces plus 3 years (additional relaxation for SC/ST/OBC as per Government of India instructions)

rows.category: TMC employees and those working in TMC on a temporary, project or contract basis

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Photocopies of the following documents are to be submitted at the time of the interview, and the original documents must also be carried for verification. Resume and 2 recent passport size photographs (mandatory) Date of birth proof: Birth Certificate, School leaving Certificate or SSC passing certificate Mark sheets and passing certificates for all examinations Experience certificate: for past employment, a certificate showing dates of joining and relieving; for current employment, the appointment letter and last pay slip Copies of PAN Card and Aadhar Card Caste certificate: a valid certificate in the Government of India format; a Caste Validity Certificate for ST; a Non-Creamy Layer Certificate for OBC candidates (mandatory) Economically Weaker Section (EWS) certificate in valid format Persons with Disability: Physical Disability Certificate. The notice also lists Autism, Intellectual Disability, Specific Learning Disability and Mental illness with disability, i.e. Specific Learning Disability (SLD). Permission from the Head of the Organization, for persons working under Central / State Government / Autonomous Body / Semi Government Organizations and other Public Sector Undertakings

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates attend the interview at the Academics department, 4th floor, Wing-C, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, New Chandigarh, Punjab-140901, between 09.00 A.M. and 11.00 A.M. Documents are verified against the originals. Tata Memorial Centre reserves the right to fix a minimum eligibility standard or benchmark and to restrict the number of candidates called for interview, taking into account factors such as the number of vacancies and percentage of marks in Graduate / Post Graduate degrees. It also reserves the right to fix a minimum eligibility standard when selecting candidates for final selection after the interview. The decision of the Director, HBCH&RC, Punjab is final and binding, and no correspondence will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Persons working under Central / State Government / Autonomous Body / Semi Government Organizations and other PSUs must obtain permission from their Head of the Organization and produce it at the interview, failing which they shall not be allowed to appear. The post is for a tenure of one year from the date of appointment. TMC may also offer appointments for a fixed term, initially for one year, on a consolidated remuneration. Appointed candidates may be rotated to any Unit of TMC as and when necessary: Tata Memorial Hospital, Mumbai; ACTREC, Navi Mumbai; Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, Sangrur; Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Mullanpur; Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Visakhapatnam; Mahamana Pt. Madan Mohan Malviya Cancer Centre (BHU), Varanasi; Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, Varanasi; BBCI, Guwahati. Sharing accommodation may be provided to Senior Residents/One Year Fellows, subject to availability, on a chargeable basis. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature. Candidature will be cancelled if the candidate does not fulfil the eligibility criteria or has given incorrect, false or incomplete information or suppressed any material fact. If a shortcoming is found even after appointment, services are liable to be terminated forthwith. For enquiries, email [email protected] . No phone calls will be entertained. faq.question: Q1. When is the HBCHRC One Year Fellow walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 18 December 2026, between 09.00 A.M. and 11.00 A.M.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at the Academics department, 4th floor, Wing-C, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Plot No. 1, Medicity, New Chandigarh, Punjab-140901.

faq.question: Q3. How many One Year Fellow posts are there?
faq.answer: There is 1 post, in Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery (Surgical Oncology).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the One Year Fellow post?
faq.answer: MCh (Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery/Plastic Surgery) or DrNB (Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery/Plastic Surgery) or equivalent recognized by MCI/NMC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum is up to 45 Yrs., counted as on the date of the walk-in interview. SC/ST get 5 years, OBC 3 years and PWD 10 years of relaxation, with the additional relaxation stated in the notice.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a One Year Fellow at HBCHRC?
faq.answer: The gross salary is Rs. 1,33,623/- to Rs. 1,45,530/- per month, determined by the relevant work experience acquired after completing the essential qualification.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring photocopies of the resume, 2 passport size photographs, age proof, mark sheets, experience certificates, PAN and Aadhar and applicable category certificates, plus the originals for verification.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: The post is for a tenure of one year from the date of appointment, and TMC may offer a fixed term initially of one year on a consolidated remuneration.

faq.question: Q9. Can government employees attend the interview?
faq.answer: Yes, but those in Central or State Government, autonomous bodies, semi-government organizations and PSUs must produce permission from their Head of the Organization, or they will not be allowed to appear.

faq.question: Q10. Is accommodation provided?
faq.answer: Sharing accommodation may be provided to One Year Fellows subject to availability, on a chargeable basis.
